svg.text: For any piano — acoustic or digital. No app, no MIDI cable.
Follow the lights. Play the song.
Works on acoustic and digital pianos
No app, no account, no MIDI cable — just your phone browser
Upload any MIDI file and follow the lit keys
Sits behind the keys on felt feet: nothing stuck to your piano
Powered by a USB-C phone charger (5 V, 3 A recommended)
• 2 × rail halves (625 mm each, black aluminum with black diffuser; 176 LEDs in total, 88 per half)
Power adapter not included. Use a USB-C or USB-A phone charger, 5 V, 3 A (15 W) recommended; use a UL/ETL-listed adapter.
DUET KEYS DK-1 · Input 5 V DC, 3 A max (USB-C)

Indoor use only. Not a toy. Read the manual before use.
DUET KEYS DK-1 shipper box — RSC, end-loading. Inside 660.4 × 101.6 × 76.2 mm (26 × 4 × 3 in). Units: mm. Flat size ≈ 736.6 × 390.6 mm.
Red solid = cut. Blue dashed = fold. Artwork carries 3.175 mm (1/8 in) bleed. Flap slots 3 mm. Board: E/B-flute white, print outside.
Panels: TOP 26×4 in, FRONT/BACK 26×3 in, BOTTOM 26×4 in (contents, compliance, barcode); end flaps close the 4×3 in ends.
PLACEHOLDER layout: the printer's own dieline template (with caliper allowances) governs final dimensions. Brand, FCC ID, company and UPC are placeholders.
